title: 第7章  婷婷，玥玥，小雅……我的青葱岁月啊！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
一路晃晃悠悠，很快抵达烟城一中校门口。
清晨的校园朝气蓬勃，穿着蓝白校服的学生们三三两两结伴入校，说说笑笑、打打闹闹，满脸都是青涩纯粹的少年气，阳光又鲜活。
看着他们脸上的笑容，林毅只是笑了笑。
别看他们现在脸上笑嘻嘻的，但真坐在教室里的那一刻，谁脸上能出现笑容，他名字倒着写！
高中他妈的又苦又累，管的还他妈的贼严！
不光进出校门要检查，还不能带任何的违禁品，体育课基本没有，就连男女生走近一点都他妈算早恋了！
据说现在还有防走神的设备，简直离谱！
但……那是别人的高中生活。
遥想当年，他高二的校园生活过得风生水起，成绩不差，日子潇洒，偏偏半路被自家老爹和爷爷硬生生送进了军营。
一纸征兵通知，直接斩断了他的高中生涯。
遥想当年的高中生活，多美好啊。
特别是婷婷的温柔、玥玥的活泼、小雅的乖巧……以及那些与他携手相伴，能够组成一个加强连的前女友们。
啊，我的青葱岁月啊！
林毅咂了咂嘴，一脸唏嘘。
也不知道这几个丫头现在怎么样了，算着时间，应该早就毕业上班，各自安稳生活了吧？
可惜了，我的青葱校园，我的美好青春啊。
就在这时，他视线随意一扫，忽然定格在不远处走来的一道熟悉身影上。
中年男人穿着整洁的正装衬衫，鼻梁上架着一副黑框眼镜，手里抱着一摞教案书本，步履沉稳，正是当年带过他的班主任刘老师。
哪怕时隔六年，模样依旧没变。
林毅眼睛一亮，张口高声喊道：“老刘！”

话音落下，他单手提着两箱沉甸甸的牛奶，脚步轻快，三步并作两步快步迎了上去。
刘老师闻声驻足，抬眼看向迎面走来的青年，目光细细打量片刻，推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，语气迟疑：“林毅？”
“可以啊老刘，六年了，你还是能一眼认出我。”林毅咧嘴一笑。
刘老师闻言忍不住轻笑一声，眼底满是无奈：“呵呵，想不
“你小子当年在学校里妥妥的风云人物，调皮捣蛋、闯祸逃课样样不落，我教过这么多学生，就你最能折腾，想忘都忘不掉。”
还有句话他没说，主要也是林毅的爷爷，跟林毅的父亲，那都是军中有地位的大佬。
他现在犹记得林毅犯了错请家长，林毅的家长还没到，校长就已经站在校门口迎接的场景……
林毅闻言也不尴尬，挠了挠头，一脸嬉笑着赔罪：“那不是年少轻狂，年轻不懂事嘛。”
“对了，老刘，你现在还当班主任吗？”他随口问道。
刘老师端正了下站姿，扶了扶鼻梁上的眼镜，严肃的半开玩笑道：“林毅同学，我纠正你一下，在学校要称呼职务，叫我教导主任。”
林毅抬手敬礼：“是，刘植物！”
“嘿——你小子？”
“嘿嘿，刘……主任！”
“你小子。”刘老师点晃着手指，笑骂一声，随口问道：“怎么突然回学校了？趁着回来探亲专门过来逛逛？”
六年过去，以林毅的家庭背景，想必已经在部队混的风生水起了。
“主要是回来找您叙叙旧。”林毅说得情真意切，一脸真诚。
刘老师看人眼光毒辣至极，哪里会信他这套说辞。
他微微眯起眼睛，看穿了林毅的小心思，摆手道：“叙旧？可拉倒吧你，你小子一向无事不登三宝殿，麻溜点，有什么事直接说。”
被老班主任一眼看穿心思，林毅也不遮掩，嘿嘿一笑，顺势说道：“还是刘老师……刘主任火眼金睛，什么都瞒不过您，这里人多眼杂，咱们进办公室细说？”
刘老师无奈摇头，对这小子的油滑性子早已习惯，当即点了点头，转身带着林毅朝着教师办公楼走去。

走进熟悉的办公室，屋内的陈设和六年前差别不大，依旧摆满了书本教案。
刘老师径直落座，刚放下手里的教案，一旁的林毅就手脚麻利地拿起桌上的水杯，接了一杯温水，轻轻放在他面前，随后乖巧地坐在旁边的椅子上，姿态端正。
刘老师低头看着桌上的温水，心生感慨：这小子，不管出去闯荡多少年，依旧这么有眼力见，嘴甜会来事，这倒是一点没变。
他抬眼看向林毅，开门见山：“行了，别端着了，说说吧，到底回来干什么的？”
林毅顺势吹捧一句，满脸赞叹：“不愧是刘老师，太厉害了，什么心思都逃不过您的眼睛。”
“少跟我贫嘴、拍马屁。”刘老师没好气地瞪了他一眼，端起水杯就喝了口水。
林毅收敛嬉皮笑脸，神色认真了几分，直白开口：“刘老师，我这次回来是想在咱们学校复读，重新考大学。”
“噗——”
刘老师听到这句话直接一口水喷了出来。
他满脸错愕地看着林毅，语气满是难以置信：“你？想复读考大学？”
按照他所想的那样，林毅这次是回来探亲的。
合着这次回来，是直接退伍了？
林毅也不隐瞒，把这六年的事情大概说了说，三次入伍，三次退伍的事情也没必要隐瞒。
了解了情况之后，刘老师放下水杯，愣了半天，若有所思。
当年林毅在高二时成绩很优异，基本稳居班级前十，是妥妥的学习好苗子，但不知为何，就过了不到两个月，成绩直线下滑，还跟不少漂亮的小姑娘谈恋爱。
结果还没到学期末，就直接不来学校了，一走就是六年，后来才知道是被家里长辈逼着去了部队。
他还惋惜了好一阵，觉得林毅只是叛逆期，及时引导纠正还有希望。
“那你这次回来，就是铁了心要复读考大学？”刘老师不确定的问道。
“是啊。”林毅点点头：“说实话，当年急匆匆入伍，没读完高中、没参加高考，我后悔好几年了，一直是个心结。”
刘老师皱紧眉头：“你家里同意了？你爸妈还有你爷爷，舍得让你回来读书？”

林毅想都没想，脱口而出：“同意！绝对同意！全家一致通过，没人反对！”
反正家里只是不同意他回部队，可没说不让他复读读书。
刘老师将信将疑，又追问：“那复读的相关手续，你都提前办好？”
“那哪能啊。”林毅摊了摊手，笑得一脸坦然，“这不是想着先来找老师您叙叙旧，等叙完旧再去办手续嘛。”
“你啊你，真是想一出是一出。”刘老师无奈扶额，苦口婆心地劝道，“要我说，你趁早打消这个念头，别折腾了，安安稳稳回去找个工作过日子多好。”
content_en:
After wandering all the way, we soon arrived at the gate of Yancheng No. 1 Lieutenant Colonel.
The campus is full of vitality in the early morning. Students wearing blue and white uniforms enter the school in twos and threes, talking, laughing, and playing around. Their faces are full of youthful and pure youthfulness, and they are sunny and lively.
Looking at the smiles on their faces, Ji Yi just smiled.
Don't look at the smiles on their faces now, but at the moment when they are sitting in the classroom, who can have a smile on their face? His name is written backwards!
High school is fucking hard and tiring, and the management is so damn strict!
Not only are you required to check when entering and exiting the school, but you are also not allowed to bring any contraband. There are basically no physical education classes. Even if a boy or girl comes closer, it is considered to be a fucking puppy love!
It is said that there is now a device to prevent mind wandering, which is simply outrageous!
But... that's someone else's high school life.
Thinking back to that year, he had a prosperous campus life in his sophomore year of high school, with good grades and a happy life. However, he was sent to the military camp by his father and grandfather halfway.
A draft notice directly cut off his high school career.
Thinking back on my high school life back then, how wonderful it was.
Especially Tingting's gentleness, Yueyue's liveliness, Xiaoya's well-behaved... and those ex-girlfriends who join hands with him to form a strengthening company.
Ah, my green years!
Lin Yi smacked his lips with a sigh on his face.
I don’t know how these girls are doing now. Considering the time, they should have graduated and gone to work long ago and lived their own stable lives, right?
What a pity, my green campus, my beautiful youth.
At this moment, he glanced at a familiar figure walking not far away.
The middle-aged man was wearing a neat formal shirt, a pair of black-rimmed glasses on the bridge of his nose, holding a stack of lesson plans in his hands, and walking steadily. He was none other than Teacher Liu, his class teacher.
Even after six years, the appearance remains the same.
Lin Yi's eyes lit up, and he opened his mouth and shouted loudly: "Old Liu!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he held two heavy boxes of milk in one hand and walked up to them with brisk steps, three steps at a time and two steps at a time.
Teacher Liu stopped when he heard the sound, raised his eyes to look at the young man walking towards him, looked at him carefully for a moment, pushed up the glasses on the bridge of his nose, and said hesitantly: "Jin Yi?"
"Okay, Old Liu, you can still recognize me at a glance after six years." Ji Yi grinned.
Teacher Liu couldn't help but chuckle when he heard this, his eyes were full of helplessness: "Haha, can't you think of it?"
"You were a popular figure in school back then. You were always naughty, getting into trouble and skipping classes. I have taught so many students, but you were the most troublesome. You will never be forgotten even if I want to. "
There was something else he didn't say. Mainly, it was Lin Yi's grandfather and Lin Yi's father, both of whom were prominent figures in the military.
He still remembers the scene when Lin Yi made the mistake of inviting parents. Before Lin Yi's parents arrived, the principal was already standing at the school gate to greet him...
Ji Yi was not embarrassed when he heard this, scratched his head, and apologized with a smile on his face: "That's not young and frivolous, young and ignorant. "
"By the way, Lao Liu, are you still the class teacher now? he asked casually.
Teacher Liu straightened his posture, adjusted his glasses on the bridge of his nose, and said seriously and half-jokingly: "Classmate Lin Yi, let me correct you. In school, you should call me the dean of teachers. "
Ji Yi raised his hand and saluted: "Yes, Liu Zhizhi! "
"Hey - you kid? "
"Hey, Director Liu...! "
"You boy. Teacher Liu waggled his finger, laughed and cursed, and asked casually: "Why did you suddenly go back to school?" Why don't you come here for a visit while you're back to visit relatives? "
Six years have passed, and given Lin Yi's family background, he must have become successful in the army.
“The main thing is to come back and catch up with you. "Ji Yi said it sincerely and with a sincere face.
Teacher Liu has a very vicious look at people, so no one would believe his words.
He narrowed his eyes slightly, saw through Ji Yi's little thoughts, waved his hand and said: "Reminiscing about the past? But pull you down, you kid alwaysIf you have nothing to do, don't go to the Three Treasures Hall. If you have anything to do, just say it directly. "
The old head teacher saw through his mind at a glance, and Lin Yi didn't hide it. He smiled and said smoothly: "It's still Teacher Liu... Director Liu has a sharp eye and can't hide anything from you. There are many people here, let's go into the office and talk in detail? "
Teacher Liu shook his head helplessly. He was already used to this guy's naughty temperament. He nodded immediately, turned around and led Lin Yi towards the teacher's office building.
Walking into the familiar office, the furnishings in the room are not much different from those six years ago. They are still filled with books and lesson plans.
Teacher Liu sat down directly. As soon as he put down the lesson plan in his hand, Ji Yi quickly picked up the water glass on the table, took a glass of warm water, placed it gently in front of him, and then sat obediently on the chair next to him with an upright posture.
Teacher Liu looked down at the warm water on the table and sighed: This kid, no matter how many years he has been out and about, he is still so discerning and sweet-talking, and this has not changed at all.
He looked up at Ji Yi and said straight to the point: "Okay, stop holding on, let's talk about it, what are you doing back here? "
Lin Yi took advantage of the situation and complimented him with admiration on his face: "As expected of Teacher Liu, you are so amazing, no thoughts can escape your eyes. "
“Stop talking nonsense and flattering me. "Teacher Liu glared at him angrily, picked up the water glass and took a sip of water.
Ji Yi stopped his playful smile, looked a little more serious, and said bluntly: "Teacher Liu, I want to repeat my studies in our school this time and take the college entrance examination again. "
"Pfft——"
When Teacher Liu heard this sentence, he immediately squirted out a mouthful of water.
He looked at Ji Yi with astonishment, and his tone was full of disbelief: "You? Want to go back to college? "
According to what he thought, Ji Yi came back to visit relatives this time.
When the co-author came back this time, did he immediately retire from the army?
Ji Yi didn't hide anything. He roughly talked about what happened in the past six years. There was no need to hide the fact that he enlisted in the army three times and was discharged three times.
After understanding the situation, Teacher Liu put down the water glass and froze for a long time, thoughtfully.
When Lin Yi was a sophomore in high school, his grades were very good, and he was basically ranked among the top ten in the class. He was a good academic prospect, but for some reason, within two months, his grades plummeted, and he fell in love with many beautiful girls.
As a result, before the end of the semester, I stopped coming to school. I left for six years. Later I found out that I was forced to join the army by my family elders.
He also regretted it for a while, feeling that Ji Yi was only in his rebellious stage, and there was still hope for timely guidance and correction.
"Then you came back this time because you were determined to re-study and take the college entrance examination? Teacher Liu asked uncertainly.
"Yeah. "Jin Yi nodded: "To be honest, I rushed to join the army without finishing high school or taking the college entrance examination. I have regretted it for several years and it has always been a knot in my heart. "
Teacher Liu frowned: "Does your family agree? Are your parents and your grandfather willing to let you come back to study? "
Ji Yi blurted out without even thinking: “Agree! Absolutely agree! The whole family passed unanimously, no one objected! "
Anyway, his family just didn't agree with him returning to the army, but they didn't say they wouldn't let him resume his studies.
Teacher Liu was doubtful and asked again: "Have you completed all the relevant procedures for re-study in advance? "
"That's not possible. "Jin Yi spread his hands and smiled calmly, "Isn't this because I want to come to you, teacher, to catch up on old times, and then go through the formalities after catching up with old times? "
"You, you, you really want to come out all the time. "Teacher Liu helplessly held his forehead and advised earnestly, "I tell you, you should give up this idea as soon as possible, don't worry about it, it would be great to go back to find a job and live a peaceful life. "
